stories.summary: A boy encounters a hungry dog on his way home from school. The dog grabs his book, causing the boy to run away in fear.

normalizations: tone: no valid values, coerced to ['other']

stories.summary: A king who loved music in his past life is reborn as a common man with the same passion. He plays music for animals and his family, eventually winning a music competition.
A monkey sneaks into a kitchen and eats some mangoes, leading to confusion when the mother thinks her child ate them. The mystery is solved when the mother discovers the mischievous monkey.
In a zoo, the animals hold a running race to determine who is fit to be the king. The Rhino wins the race and becomes the new king of the zoo.
Monkey sneaks into the kitchen to eat mangoes, causing chaos and scaring the aunty. The child cries, but the aunty calms them down and the monkey leaves happily after eating the mangoes.
A mischievous monkey enters a home, causing chaos by eating all the food. The homeowner arrives and manages to send the monkey back where it came from.
A Honey Bee goes on a journey, collecting honey from different flowers with a group of Bees following along. In the end, they all gather the honey.
A mischievous monkey in a village causes trouble by entering a house and eating all the food, leaving chaos behind.
Ramu the Lion and his best friend Hoggy the tiger go to the river to drink water, where they encounter talking fish before heading back home.
When the teacher is absent, the naughty students take charge in the classroom. One student becomes the teacher and leads a fun lesson for everyone.
The story describes a child's activities on the day of Diwali, including waking up early, performing rituals, lighting diyas, and enjoying fireworks with family and friends.

A man adopts a dog named Reggie from a shelter, but struggles to bond with him. After finding a letter from Reggie's previous owner, the man learns more about the dog's true name, Tank, and the special bond they shared.
Granny reminisces about the bond she shared with sparrows in the past. She longs for her bird friend to return and is overjoyed when it finally does, fulfilling her wish.
Manya struggles to find the perfect dress for a party, trying on various outfits without success. In the end, she discovers the perfect dress in her own wardrobe and wears it to the party.

Didi finds abandoned children, educates and raises them as her own, teaching them to read, write, and draw. After a natural disaster, the children have to move to the mountains but eventually return to the village where Didi continues to teach them.

source.title: Shruti's secret to winning
source.author: Anushka and Preeti Praveen
source.illustrator: Deepa Balsavar, Greystroke, Henu, Rajiv Eipe, Sheetal Thapa, Soumya Menon, Suvidha Mistry..

stories.summary: Shruti is a smart girl who wins competitions. Everyone wants to know her secret, so she invites her teacher to stay with her. Through hard work and practice, Shruti wins a dance competition, revealing that practice makes perfect.
A child describes their best friend who lives with them and is always there, even in their dreams. They play together all day and are inseparable.
Anand, a boy from the Alimathi family, dreams of becoming a pilot despite his family's varied expectations. Encouraged by his parents, he decides to follow his dreams.

Tita plays with her mother's saree despite her mother's disapproval. When she learns her mother is going to a neighboring village, she takes the initiative to iron all her clothes, earning praise from her mother.
Shambu, a junior explorer, finds a tiny man in the forest who is lost and shelterless. He offers the man shelter until the rain stops, and they spend the day playing together before parting ways.

source.title: Amma's stories
source.author: Rachita Uday Kumar
source.illustrator: Anupama Ajinkya Apte, Kaveri Gopalakrishnan, Mayur Mistry, Priya Kuriyan, Sanjay Sarkar, Santosh Pujari, Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja, Taposhi Ghoshal

stories.summary: A collection of everyday stories featuring characters like Hooja Singh, Meenu, Rohan, Dooli, Chameli, Leena, Bela, and a student's teacher, Mrs. Mekala Aunty, each facing different challenges and learning valuable lessons.
Ruchi's beloved cat Reena goes missing one day, leading Ruchi on a search throughout the town. After much heartbreak, Ruchi is overjoyed to be reunited with her precious pet.

Avanti, the zookeeper, celebrates Ballu the bear's birthday with a party. When Ballu blows out the candles, it causes a strange rain of fish. Together, they collect the fish and enjoy the magical moment.
Rachel dreams of an adventure with her stuffed toy, Big Ben, in a jungle. When they get separated in a storm, Rachel saves Big Ben and surprises him with a birthday party by the river.

The story follows a messy rat with a beautiful long tail and cute ears that causes chaos in the house by chewing on papers and veggies. It's a humorous tale of a little grey mouse's mischievous adventures.

All the animals in the jungle are worried about the continuous cutting of trees by humans, leading to a shortage of space for them. Mr. Elephant calls for a meeting to discuss the issue and find a solution for their coming generations' shelter.
The story describes various whimsical scenarios where different objects and creatures are seen flying in the wind, sparking the reader's imagination.

An old widow burdened by mistreatment from her sons and daughters-in-law finds solace by sharing her sorrows with the walls of a decaying house, causing them to crumble and release her emotional weight. She returns home feeling lighter and relieved.

source.title: It's bath time!
source.author: Akshara Rajesh
source.illustrator: Rijuta Ghate, Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja

stories.summary: Nandu and Chinku have a fun bath time with their toy elephant, play in the water, get clean with soap bubbles, and then have dinner before bedtime.

Lily the deer and her clever bird friend Coco encounter a wolf named Ham who tries to trick Lily into a trap. With quick thinking and teamwork, Lily and Coco outsmart the wolf and a farmer, ultimately escaping unharmed.

Keshav Mukherjee, a shopkeeper, has a bad day and loses his temper, causing chaos in his village. His family helps him realize his mistake, leading to a heartwarming resolution where he shows kindness to a beggar and gains back the trust of his community.

Windy, a personified wind, discovers a hidden village under her town and befriends a little girl. Together, they embark on an adventure to the clouds where the children experience the joy of flying and exploring a new world.

source.title: The book of poems
source.author: Rachita Uday Kumar
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Angie & Upesh, Bulbul Sharma, Kaveri Gopalakrishnan, Priya Kuriyan

stories.summary: The story consists of a collection of poems about habits, a butterfly, a snare, silver, and the seaside. Each poem explores different themes and settings in a poetic and descriptive manner.
The story follows Dia and her family as they celebrate various festivals like Holi, Dussehera, Onam, and Diwali. Each festival involves different traditions, activities, and food preparations.

source.title: The Magical Jackal
source.author: Gabriella Robes
source.illustrator: Aryan Deepak, Helga Parekh, Kruttika Susarla, Sonal Goyal, Sukhada Rahalkar, Sumit Sakhuja

stories.summary: Andi, intrigued by a mystical light in the forest, sets out to discover its source. She encounters a magical jackal that leaves her with a mysterious experience she shares with her grandchildren.
Ridhima and Rohan love painting and win art prizes. When they move to a new house, they paint it beautifully and start their own shop, becoming world-famous artists.
Grandma loves juggling but struggles with mangoes until she gets a set of juggling balls from grandpa. With her new balls, she becomes a professional juggler and the best in the world.

source.title: Nina Plays With the Butterflies
source.author: Adhvika Deepak
source.illustrator: Herminder Ohri, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Priya Kuriyan, Sanjay Sarkar, Sorit Gupto

stories.summary: Nina loves butterflies and tries to play with them, but they keep flying away. After several attempts, she finally succeeds in playing with the butterflies and shares the joy with her mother.

Gargi loves playing in the sand and avoiding cleanliness, until she falls ill and dreams of a battle against germs. With the help of her soap friend Soapy, she learns the importance of hygiene and friendship.

Yusuf, a bus conductor, helps a stranded girl on a lonely road at night, ensuring her safety on the bus. His kind actions lead to a positive news story that highlights the importance of decency and helping others.

The story follows Lord Rama and his army as they build a bridge to rescue his wife Sita from Lanka. Set in the historical and cultural location of Dhanushkodi, the tale is filled with mystery and excitement.

source.title: Aditi's Trip To Moon
source.author: Rajalakshmi Paramasivam
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Greystroke, Helga Parekh, Rijuta Ghate, Sorit Gupto, Suvidha Mistry, Taposhi Ghoshal

stories.summary: Aditi dreams of going to the moon, where she builds a sand castle and explores, but gets lost and scared. A fluffy cloud helps her return home, turning her adventure into a dream.
A child is hungry and decides to pick bananas from a tree. They eat many bananas and then come up with a creative idea to make banana halwa, which makes them happy.

source.title: Hacking Is Life Part 2 - The Kid Can't Be Kidnapped
source.author: the- okers

stories.summary: Alex, a 12-year-old school kid, discovers that his virus has affected over 99 million people. He decides to use his hacking skills for good, helping those in need and outsmarting greedy hackers. When confronted by some individuals seeking his hacking abilities, Alex cleverly escapes and returns home safely.
Dia struggles to choose a topic for her project until her Dadhi suggests doing it on Diwali. With his help, she creates a wonderful project that impresses her classmates and teacher.
Mittai Lal, a sweet-loving character, dreams of indulging in his favorite treats but ends up falling off his bed and breaking his arm.

source.title: Intelligent Friends
source.author: Venkat Pavan
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Padmanabh, Santosh Pujari, Tapas Guha

stories.summary: Ramu, a 5-year-old boy, and his best friend Raj the rabbit, along with their friend Sita, go to the forest to get orange fruits. They encounter a lion who challenges their intelligence, leading to a heartwarming resolution where their cleverness shines through.

A little girl receives a Teddy Bear and a Barbie doll as birthday gifts. She neglects to take care of them, leading her mother to throw them away. After a day of fun at an exhibition, the girl learns the importance of responsibility and cleanliness.
A girl and a bear become friends in a forest during a rainy day. The bear helps the girl by providing food, and they celebrate the bear's birthday together with a surprise cake.

source.title: Hooray!!! It's Sunday- Time for Leisure Shower and Fun time
source.author: Reshma Krishnamurthy Sharma

stories.summary: Chinnu and Puttu are woken up by Mama on a Sunday morning for a fun-filled day. Initially reluctant to take a bath, they end up having a great time playing with water toys in the tubs.

source.title: Viva.., the curious girl
source.author: Swathi Vivo
source.illustrator: Greystroke, Sheetal Thapa, Sorit Gupto, Soumya Menon

stories.summary: Viva, a curious girl from a village, learns about nature and the world around her through her teacher's guidance. She observes butterflies, flowers, and clouds, finding joy in connecting classroom lessons to real-life experiences.
Two best friends, Salima and Begum, are separated when Begum's family moves to Hyderabad. They both search for each other and eventually reunite, living happily ever after.

A boy named Danim gets his hand stuck in a narrow hole while trying to retrieve his pocket money that fell in. With the help of a kind lady and firefighters, he is rescued and learns a valuable lesson about saving money.

source.title: App-ily ever after
source.author: Debleena Roy
source.illustrator: Delwyn Remedios, ayyagari anju, pradnya ns

stories.summary: Sujata helps King Bholu, the king of a lost kingdom, find his way using a magical app called Moogle Maps. With the app's help, Bholu can now navigate his kingdom without getting lost and even invites everyone to his birthday party.

source.title: Wonders of Martina's Adventure
source.author: Anusri
source.illustrator: Prashant Miranda, Sangeeta Das, Sanjay Sarkar, Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja

stories.summary: Martina, an adventurous explorer, finds a mysterious map in a bottle and embarks on a journey with her friends to a beautiful island. They encounter diverse flora and fauna, explore caves with ancient paintings, and make exciting discoveries before returning home.

source.title: Cinderella
source.author: Reddi Sai
source.illustrator: Lovely Samhitha, Naishmika Gopisetty, Radhika Pendse, ayyagari anju

stories.summary: Cinderella, a kind girl mistreated by her stepmother and stepsisters, receives help from birds to attend a royal event where she captures the prince's heart and marries him.
The birds decide to choose a king by seeing who can fly the highest. The smallest bird, Ncede, cleverly becomes the king by holding onto the Vulture's feathers as he soars into the sky.

Ramesh, a brave and wise boy, embarks on a journey to visit his mother. Along the way, he encounters a thief in the forest and cleverly outwits him with the help of his mother and the villagers, ultimately capturing the long sought-after criminal.

source.title: Queen's Village
source.author: Lakshmi Prasanna
source.illustrator: Lovely Samhitha, anil k, ayyagari anju

stories.summary: A beauty queen in the village of Tungatoor falls sick and passes away, leading to disturbances in the kingdom. When a girl named Devishta is born in the same family, the kingdom returns to its former state, but the mystery behind the queen's death and the village's troubles remains unsolved.

source.title: Croaky the Frog
source.author: Aahan Sarin
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Greystroke, Ketan Raut, Santosh Pujari, Srikrishna Kedilaya

stories.summary: Croaky the Frog, who could talk like humans but not croak like a frog, seeks help to learn how to croak. With the assistance of a kind man and Google, Croaky practices and successfully learns to croak, living up to his name.
An owl wakes up during the day to help a fallen bird with the assistance of other birds. After the rescue, the birds celebrate and the owl goes back to sleep.

source.title: Abhinav and the Cat
source.author: Rajalakshmi Paramasivam
source.illustrator: Anita Sivakumar, Deepa Balsavar, Henu, Priya Kuriyan, Ruchi Shah, Sanjay Sarkar

stories.summary: Abhinav mistakes a cat for his favorite cartoon character Oggy and starts feeding it milk. Eventually, he learns the importance of sharing and caring for others.

source.title: The Avengers and the age of powerful mach Green Goblin
source.author: Kalaiarasi Ramanan

stories.summary: The Avengers, including Vision, Captain America, War Machine, Scarlet, and Romanof, must rescue Captain who gets into trouble with the Green Goblin in the woods. They fight together and defeat the villain, ensuring peace in Avengers headquarters.

source.title: Food makes everything better!
source.author: Rachita Uday Kumar
source.illustrator: Delwyn Remedios, Lovely Samhitha, Priya Kuriyan, Taposhi Ghoshal

stories.summary: Various children face different challenges and feel sad, but after receiving their favorite foods from loved ones, they feel better and happier.

Rosella admires the beauty of the world while Rangan worries about those who may harm it. They imagine various monsters threatening the earth but ultimately emphasize the importance of keeping it safe.
After losing her parents, Zara lives with her stepmother and stepsisters. When a fairy helps her attend a palace ball, Zara has a wonderful time and surprises her family.

source.title: The Clever Tortoise and the Foolish Fox
source.author: Likhith Avileli

stories.summary: A clever tortoise outsmarts a foolish fox who tries to eat him by tricking the fox into putting him in the water, where he can swim away to safety.

source.title: My family
source.author: Jyothi Tanu
source.illustrator: Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja, ayyagari anju

stories.summary: A small and happy family consisting of a mother, father, and two children, Ram and Ramya, enjoy spending time together. The father, Ram, provides for his family and brings joy with toys and outings. As the children grow up, they pursue their own paths while cherishing the memories of their close-knit family.

Anna gets lost in a jungle while hiking and befriends a bear named Golu. Together, they search for their way home, facing challenges like hunger and storms, but eventually find their way back and become close friends.

Sheema plays in the mud, gets scolded by her mother, then dreams of being a princess captured by bugs. King Kenrykoof comes to her rescue with his army, and they defeat the bugs. Sheema celebrates by building a castle.

source.title: Akash's sweet lesson to brush
source.author: Nisha Sridhar
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Archana Sreenivasan, Greystroke, Hari Kumar Nair, Lavanya Karthik, Ruchi Shah, Sorit Gupto

stories.summary: Akash loves sweets but refuses to brush his teeth, until he has a scary dream about a tooth monster. After the fright, he decides to start brushing regularly to keep his teeth safe and enjoy his treats.

source.title: God
source.author: Murthy Pannala
source.illustrator: Nidhi Jha, Nimret Handa, P. G. Dinesh, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Shikha Gupta, Wiehan de Jager, Zainab Tambawalla

stories.summary: God comes to earth and transforms into different objects to help and interact with humans, ultimately deciding to take human form to better assist them.

source.title: Truth Alone Triumphs
source.author: Bharadwaj K P
source.illustrator: Angie & Upesh, Deval Maniar, Greystroke, Suvidha Mistry, Rakesh Naidu

stories.summary: Vladmir, a young boy in Russia, longed to play in the snow but was forbidden by his parents due to the cold. Despite this, he sneaked out to build a snowman. When caught, he chose to tell the truth and faced the consequences, learning the value of honesty.

source.title: Silly & Billy Meet the Ministry of Petrol Pumps
source.author: Dhairya Salwan
source.illustrator: Ruchi Shah, Shweta Mohapatra, Tapas Guha

stories.summary: Silly the donkey and Billy the goat decide to meet the Ministry of Petrol Pumps after watching it on TV. They embark on a journey, facing some challenges along the way, and eventually meet the Ministry before returning home happily.

source.title: Rizwan and his friends having fun in the snow
source.author: Reshma Krishnamurthy Sharma

stories.summary: Rizwan and his friends enjoy a day playing in the snow near the Himalayan range, building snowmen and having fun. They appreciate the joy of nature and share their experiences with others.
Three warriors fight evil to protect India, lose, then fight back and reclaim their land. They celebrate by dancing and swimming at the beach.
The story introduces various sea creatures like seahorses, octopuses, clownfish, dolphins, sea turtles, manta rays, and starfishes, describing where they are found in the ocean.

source.title: How Does the Toothpaste Get into the Tube?
source.author: Veena Prasad

stories.summary: In 1870, a boy named Lucius discovers a better way to use toothpaste after being disgusted by sharing a jar with family members. He learns from artists in Paris and invents the toothpaste tube. The story explains the process of filling toothpaste tubes and shares ancient Indian dental wisdom.

Tilia and Max live in Carlafonia in the 1960s where they struggle to brush their teeth with wood and cream. When the country starts complaining about the toothpaste, Mr. Wilbur comes up with a creative solution by making toothpaste in tubes with new ingredients like fruits and vegetables.

source.title: And this is how the earth got colour.
source.author: Krutarth Shah
source.illustrator: Greystroke, Ketan Raut, Muniza Shariq, Nimret Handa, Phidi Pulu

stories.summary: An artist paints the world in colors, starting with the trees, earth, animals, and sea creatures. He marvels at the beauty of the sky and wonders who painted it.

source.title: Oliver beats his problem!
source.author: Anirudh Raghava
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Priya Kuriyan, Rajeev Verma 'Banjara', Rijuta Ghate, Soumya Menon, rakesh naidu

stories.summary: Oliver struggles with being overweight due to unhealthy eating habits but with the support of his mom, he starts exercising and eating healthy to participate in a school race. After hard work and dedication, Oliver wins the race and feels proud of his achievement.

source.title: My brother
source.author: Jyothi Tanu
source.illustrator: Rijuta Ghate, Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja

stories.summary: After their mother's death, young Ram takes on the responsibility of caring for his sister Sita, working hard to provide for her and ensure she gets an education. Years later, Sita becomes successful and returns the favor by taking care of Ram, leading them to a comfortable life.

The story explores the fascinating world of bees, explaining how they buzz, carry pollen, and help plants grow. It also shares interesting facts about bees and encourages readers to learn more about these amazing creatures.

Lord Indra sends a blue dragon with the ability to breathe clouds to help a land struck by drought. The dragon overcomes the challenge of avoiding water to bring rain and happiness to the people, eventually turning the land into the 'land of clouds'.

source.title: Our easy escape
source.author: Aryan NK
source.illustrator: Angie & Upesh, Greystroke, Henu, ayyagari anju

stories.summary: A boy hears strange sounds from a haunted house and decides to investigate, despite his mother's warnings. Inside, he encounters a scared man who helps them escape using a clever idea involving headphones.
Hyena, curious about Raven's white meat, tries to fly with Raven's help but ends up falling and getting injured, losing his friendship with Raven.

source.title: Starry and the land of the unknown
source.author: Rachita Uday Kumar

stories.summary: Starry, a dragon who breathes clouds, embarks on a journey to an unfamiliar land suffering from drought. With his unique abilities, he brings life back to the land and is hailed as a hero, but all he truly desires is to live a happy life in the land of the unknown.

source.title: A Kind Boy.
source.author: Arushi Raj
source.illustrator: Kaveri Gopalakrishnan, Madhuvanti Anantharajan, Rajiv Eipe, Rijuta Ghate, Soumya Menon, Suvidha Mistry

stories.summary: A boy named Raj helps a man in need at a museum, following his mother's teachings. His act of kindness is rewarded at a school event where he is recognized for his good deeds.

The moon and the stars are good friends who play together in the night sky. When the moon gets upset and says mean things to the stars, they stop coming out to play. With the help of Mr. Sun, the moon realizes his mistake, apologizes, and the stars return to fill the sky with their sparkle.

Mavis, a fifth-grader, discovers a poster about a competition for fruits, veggies, and flowers. She finds her tomato has grown extremely large and enters it in the competition, winning multiple awards.

source.title: The bizarre island
source.author: Aditya nema
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Deepa Balsavar, Greystroke, Naishmika Gopisetty, Rajiv Eipe, Ruchi Shah, Suvidha Mistry

stories.summary: Rahul and his friend Javed are pulled into a portal and find themselves in a bizarre island facing a dwarf dinosaur named Draco. Through courage and unexpected kindness, they befriend Draco and return home with an honor medal.

source.title: Long Live Friendship! A Humorous Play for Children
source.author: Meera Dixit

stories.summary: A group of friends must outsmart Yamdoot, the messenger of Yamraja, who tries to take their friend Vikram away due to a misunderstanding about his illness. Through humor and clever tactics, the friends manage to convince Yamraja to let Vikram stay, showcasing the power of friendship.

Anu struggles with concentration at school, leading to poor marks and a note from her teacher. Worried about her parents' reaction, she is pleasantly surprised by their loving and forgiving response, leading to a resolution to do better in the future.

source.title: Chottu - The Little Boy
source.author: Tulika Bathija
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Angie & Upesh, Deepa Balsavar, Mohammad Faraaz, Rajeev Verma 'Banjara', Rijuta Ghate, Ruchi Shah, Siraj Saxena, Soumya Menon, Suvidha Mistry, Tanaya Vyas

stories.summary: Chottu, a little boy, wins a football game and faces teasing at school. Determined to grow taller, he starts skipping daily and eventually stops the teasing by growing tall.

A king and his friend face various challenges, with the friend always believing that 'Everything happens for the good'. When the king loses his thumb due to a mistake by the friend, he is initially angry but later realizes that it saved him from cannibals. The story highlights the importance of perspective and trust in difficult situations.
Lalu the owl organizes a party for all his bird friends in the jungle, where they dance and gift him a crown of feathers. After the fun-filled celebration, Lalu sleeps happily.

source.title: Why Does A Poori Puff Up?
source.author: Varsha Joshi

stories.summary: Aditi and Aarav wonder why pooris puff up and learn about the science behind it through observing and asking questions at home. They discover the role of proteins in wheat flour and the process of gluten formation that causes pooris to puff.
A cactus and a bear work together to fix a flickering ceiling lamp during a rainy day. The bear's height helps solve the problem, and the cactus appreciates the help.

Balloo the Rabbit finds a beautiful kite stuck in a tree and tries to retrieve it, but a bird takes it away. All the animals in the jungle want the kite, leading to chaos. After a struggle, Balloo manages to save the kite and his mother helps fix it, leading to a heartwarming gift to his friend Appu the elephant.

Drigo, a giant dragon, sets off to explore the solar system. Landing on a planet, he unknowingly eats alien chillies that make him breathe fire. After finding water and encountering another dragon, Drigo continues his search for his own planet, lost in space.

A skilled carpenter decides to retire but agrees to build one last house for his employer. He puts minimal effort into the project, only to realize at the end that the house is a gift for him. The story teaches the importance of giving your best effort in everything you do.
Chhoti, a young girl, explores the forest and encounters a mysterious footprint. She meets Bade, a friendly elephant, who takes her on adventures through the forest every day.

source.title: Why Can't We Glow Like Fireflies?
source.author: Nabanita Deshmukh

stories.summary: The story explores the fascinating world of fireflies, explaining how they glow and why. It delves into the science behind their luminescence and their unique behaviors.
Varun goes on a journey during his summer holidays and encounters various dragons in a magical land. His dreams become reality as he experiences thrilling adventures with these mythical creatures.
A little blue Alien with a magic wand gets lost on a red planet and meets an astronaut who helps him find his way to Earth, a colorful and beautiful place.

A child discovers they have turned into an alien and embarks on a quest to find out why, traveling to Mars with a friend to search for answers. Through a series of magical events involving a mysterious wand and a flying cap, the child eventually finds a way to return home and be cured.
A gallant knight searches for Eldorado but grows old without finding it. He encounters a pilgrim shadow and asks where Eldorado is, but the shadow does not know.

Gagan the Giraffe encounters danger when a lion plans to eat him, but is saved by another lion named Lali who becomes his friend. Lali helps Gagan escape to safety, teaching him the value of friendship.

source.title: Oh the Way We Ran, in the Fish Rain
source.author: Yamini

stories.summary: Akira and her pet cat Zero have to run through a rain of falling fish to reach school on time. Along the way, they encounter a market street filled with people catching fish and finally witness a beautiful rainbow as the fish rain stops.

source.title: The Indigo Fairy and the Lizard
source.author: Dinaz Irani

stories.summary: Kian, a fairy, seeks shelter from the rain and meets a lizard who explains its role in the ecosystem. Kian learns about different ways of saying hello and the importance of being polite.
Mintoo helps his granny sell cabbages at the market and discovers a scared, fat goat. He brings the goat home, takes care of her, and is delighted when she gives birth to a baby goat.

source.title: Jack and Anny go to space
source.author: Kalyani Radhakrishnan
source.illustrator: Greystroke, Kavita Singh Kale, Somesh Kumar

stories.summary: Jack and Anny dream of going to space but are told they are too young. They grow up, work hard, and eventually get a job that takes them to space. They explore Mars, take pictures, and become celebrated for their achievements.
The story provides tips on engaging with wordless stories, encouraging children to explore details, start discussions, and create their own narratives using visuals.

source.title: The Indigo Fairy and the Water Buffaloes
source.author: Dinaz Irani

stories.summary: The Indigo Fairy, Kian, meets a herd of water buffaloes by a river and learns the value of peace and love through their interactions. They play games and share moments of joy together, teaching Kian important life lessons.

source.title: The Indigo Fairy and the Frogs
source.author: Dinaz Irani

stories.summary: Kian, an Indigo Fairy child, embarks on a journey to find his flower guide with the help of friendly frogs in the forest. Along the way, he learns valuable lessons about patience, kindness, and the importance of the journey itself.
Fonky the frog meets his fish friends at the pond for a fun day of playing catch and cooking. When a mysterious radio appears, they have a fishy party filled with dancing and excitement.

Bhalu the bear befriends a talking tree in the woods, who provides him with cool breezes. They share moments together, take photos, and express their unbreakable friendship. The story ends with Bhalu feeling grateful for the gift of friendship.
A bear enjoys a beautiful day in nature, taking photos to capture memories. Eventually, the bear realizes that the best way to cherish the moment is to simply enjoy it without the camera.
Gabbar, a crocodile scared of swimming, overcomes his fear to save his friend Gogalguy. With the help of other animals, Gabbar learns to swim and becomes a hero in the process.

Sarla learns about how birds and aeroplanes fly through her interest in flight. She discovers the differences between bird flight and human flight, as well as the mechanics behind aeroplanes taking off and landing.
Chulli, a shy train, is fascinated with cows but gets scared when he encounters one on his tracks.

normalizations: confidence.protagonist_type: 'personified object/nature' unrecognized, set to null

stories.summary: Moti the rat and Mohan the elephant are friends who live in a forest. When Mohan gets trapped in a net, Moti comes to his rescue by cutting the net with its sharp teeth. Mohan is freed, and they live happily ever after.

Tooka, Poi, and their dog Inji love collecting seeds. One day, they meet a talking tamarind tree named Pacha who teaches them about seeds and how they grow into trees. The children learn about different seeds and their uses, appreciating the wonders of nature.

source.title: Life full of dreams
source.author: Batul Bhanpurawala
source.illustrator: Aditi Dilip, Lavanya Karthik, Manjari Chakravarti, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Vibhash Pandey

stories.summary: Mansha, raised by her granny, dreams of becoming like the flowers, birds, and stars she sees in nature. Her granny encourages her to dream big and have patience and courage to make her dreams come true.

source.title: Sam the Dragon
source.author: Menaka Raman
source.illustrator: Priya Kuriyan, Somesh Kumar, Suvidha Mistry, Vinayak Varma

stories.summary: Sam the dragon, a flying lighthouse, gets lost and wants to find his way back home. With the help of a girl named Sham, he follows the Dragon Train and reunites with his parents.
Nanni tries to find a special birthday gift for her balding Dodappa, eventually coming up with a humorous idea to give him 'hair' as a present.
Natasha, a curious girl, finds a personal diary and learns a valuable lesson about respecting others' privacy and the concept of irony.

Reeti, feeling lonely during her holidays, gets a pet parrot named Mithu. She tries to teach him to talk but he only says 'hello'. When Mithu flies away to join other parrots, Reeti learns to let him go and finds happiness in reuniting with her friends at school.

A baby dinosaur named Tiny foot and her Mama embark on a journey to find a new land after an earthquake. Along the way, they encounter different dinosaurs, face a threat from velociraptors, and are saved by a brave Ankylosaurus. Eventually, they find a beautiful valley and make new friends.

Shriya feels lonely with no kids in her neighborhood, so her dad gets her a pet parrot named Piyali. When Piyali becomes sad and misses her family, Shriya selflessly sets her free to be with them, learning the importance of friendship and making new friends in the process.
Lilly receives a parrot named Yuri for her birthday. She neglects him, causing Yuri to act out. Lilly realizes her mistake, sets Yuri free, and learns the importance of friends and family.

Gini, Jojo, and their dog Tommy meet Mr. Talking Tree in Alpha Town, who teaches them to appreciate different tastes by offering them various food items. They learn to enjoy and be grateful for the meals they receive.
Ananya decorates her house and celebrates Diwali with her friends by bursting crackers, while being reminded by her parents to do so carefully.
Madhu dreams of becoming a pilot after having a dream about flying. With the guidance of her teacher, she learns about airplanes and expresses her aspirations to fly high.

source.title: Rupa's Vacation...!!
source.author: Bhasyati Sinha
source.illustrator: Ajanta Guhathakurta, Henu, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Priya Kuriyan, Rijuta Ghate, Saurabh Pandey, Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja, Suvidha Mistry, Taposhi Ghoshal

stories.summary: Rupa goes on a summer vacation to visit her friends in a small town. They spend their days playing, visiting a farm, and enjoying family time. When it's time to leave, Rupa hides to avoid going back to school, causing a bit of chaos before being found and allowed to stay another day.

Anty, a little black ant, shows courage and kindness by helping a squirrel named Browny who is in trouble during the cold winter. With the help of her friends, they push Browny into a warm burrow and become known as 'Anty's team.'

source.title: Karthik loves to read
source.author: Anusha Parthasarathy
source.illustrator: Deepa Balsavar, Greystroke, Nina Sabnani, Rajeev Verma 'Banjara', Rijuta Ghate

stories.summary: Karthik loves to read about animals and spends his time reading with his friend Kavya. He enjoys books and shares his love for reading with his family.

source.title: Terrific Trio
source.author: Vinuta Shirgopikar
source.illustrator: Deepa Balsavar, Priya Kuriyan, Santosh Pujari

stories.summary: Siblings Aditya, Vidya, and Vedant learn to appreciate their pet dog ILU, despite initial differences. Vidya's change of heart brings the family closer together.

source.title: Mango Tango
source.author: Reshma Jannath
source.illustrator: Archana Sreenivasan, Greystroke, Jagdish Joshi, Ketan Raut, Nimret Handa, Rijuta Ghate, Sanjay Sarkar, Sonal Gupta

stories.summary: Nayana and Zia plant a mango seed that grows into a magical tree, with the help of their friends and some whimsical creatures. The tree brings joy and wonder to everyone around.

source.title: The Monkey in You
source.author: Menaka Raman
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Deepa Balsavar, Greystroke, Priya Kuriyan, Rajiv Eipe, Ruchi Shah, Santosh Pujari, Tapas Guha

stories.summary: The story follows a mischievous monkey who swings high and low, always on the move and thinking about food. The monkey's antics in the tree lead to some consequences.

Basha wants to cook a special biryani for 24 people when his Ammi falls ill. With the help of his sister Sainabi, he learns to calculate the ingredients and successfully surprises his family with a delicious meal.

Lalu the owl organizes a party for all his friends in the jungle, but feels sad when his best friend Rainbow, the peacock, doesn't show up. After waiting anxiously, Rainbow finally arrives, bringing joy and happiness back to Lalu.

Devi, a 10-year-old girl from the future, befriends a robot named Bonda who helps her with various tasks. Devi trains Bonda to assist her using programming, and they share a special bond until Bonda experiences a malfunction. Devi takes care of Bonda, showing her deep care and friendship.
Bhola explores nature, reads books, and plays with imaginary animal friends, realizing that he is never truly alone as the world around him offers endless possibilities for fun and companionship.
Crocky the crocodile is sad because he has no friends to play with. Babloo, Tutoo, Susie, Fred, and Fenny all offer to play with him, and Crocky finds new friends and becomes happy.

source.title: Tintu's Day at Garden
source.author: Ambika Balamurugan
source.illustrator: Kabini Amin, Muniza Shariq, Rajeev Verma 'Banjara', Soumya Menon

stories.summary: Tintu spends a day playing with his garden friends and ends up making a delicious soup for a beetle who asked for something delicious to eat.

source.title: Tilly and Kyle make Vegetable Curry
source.author: David Keeler

stories.summary: Tilly and Kyle, hungry and alone at home, decide to surprise their grandmother by making a vegetable curry for dinner. Despite the hard work, they enjoy cooking together and successfully prepare a delicious meal just in time for their family and friends to arrive.

source.title: The Many Tails of Jiril the Squirrel
source.author: Jill Keeler

stories.summary: Jiril the squirrel feels lonely and searches for his friends, only to find them after a nap. He is happy to be reunited with them.

Danny the Dragon loses his ability to breathe fire after a trick by other dragons, but with the help of a Chilly Monster and some red chillies, he regains his fiery power and becomes the King of the dragons once more.

Langlen learns about traits and heredity from her parents while observing kittens. She questions where her dimples went and discovers the concept of traits disappearing. The story ends with a cozy family moment enjoying hot vadas together.

Neha and her friend Aiyana spend a day together in a beautiful park, enjoying various activities and magical moments. Neha plans a surprise for her friend on her birthday, leading to a heartwarming conclusion.

source.title: Browny The Horse
source.author: Rajalakshmi Paramasivam
source.illustrator: Greystroke, Jagdish Joshi, Prashant Miranda, Reshma Barve, Ruchi Shah, Rupa Prakash, Sanjay Sarkar, Zainab Tambawalla, aditi rajaraman

stories.summary: Browny, the favorite horse of a King, escapes from the palace in search of freedom. He encounters various dangers, makes friends, and eventually realizes the value of safety and comfort in the palace stable.

Fatima discovers a tiny book from the Up World and befriends Gopa, a dormouse. Together, they explore the forest canopy, meet various creatures, and help a snake find a new home, uniting the Up and Down Worlds in friendship.

source.title: We Don't Pick Up Dog Family
source.author: Oviee Sarwate

stories.summary: A dog with many friends wants fewer friends but ends up making new ones. Some dogs get taken home as pets by two girls, but they run away and cause trouble at school. The story ends with the children being scolded by their parents.

source.title: The Big Game
source.author: Karuna JP
source.illustrator: Lavanya Karthik, Shailja Jain Chougule, Sonal Gupta, Soumya Menon

stories.summary: Oli and her friends are part of a football team called 'Goal'. When their coach gets injured, a new coach named Helen steps in. With some unexpected twists and turns, the team faces off against 'Double Trouble' in the Big Game and emerges victorious.

Mani, feeling overwhelmed by the talking objects in his house, runs away without his guiding Amulet. Lost and scared, he learns the importance of the interconnected objects and the comfort of his home.

Jadav, a tree-planter, transforms a barren no-tree-place into a lush forest by planting trees over many years. His efforts attract various creatures, turning the area into a vibrant ecosystem. Inspired by Jadav's real-life story, the narrative highlights the importance of conservation and the impact of one person's dedication to nature.
A dreamy cat envisions fishes falling from the sky and believes that eating them will transform her into a tiger.

source.title: Nanni and the Oil Spill
source.author: Paroma Sengupta
source.illustrator: Lavanya Karthik, Siraj Saxena, Tessa Welch

stories.summary: Nanni, a young bird, goes on an adventure to explore a big ship near the sea. She ends up getting her wings coated in oil and has to be rescued by her parents, who give her a bath and a lesson in paying attention.

A little boy discovers a photo album with only his parents' pictures and wonders where he is in the memories. His mother tells him a whimsical story of how he used to live in the clouds as a baby before coming into their lives.

Ananya's messy desk leads her to a magical adventure with an ant named Cheenu, who takes her to an anthill for a clean desk competition. With the help of various insects and birds, Ananya transforms her messy desk into a beautiful, natural workspace and wins second place.

A family faces a pickle-making challenge when a picky relative is coming to visit. Different neighbors unknowingly create unique versions of mango pickle, leading to a surprising outcome when the relative arrives.

A student is tasked with being a mentor to a new student with a prosthetic hand. Through a series of letters, the protagonist shares their thoughts, feelings, and experiences as they navigate friendship, curiosity, and understanding.

Jamun, recovering from an illness, wishes to go outside. Her grandpa comes up with a solution - a prayer wheel that allows her friends to take turns wheeling her around in a wheelchair, fulfilling her wish.

Ranjit waits anxiously for his parents to return home, feeling lonely and uneasy. With the help of a caring friend's mother, he finds comfort and support until his parents arrive, ending the day happily.

The story explores the concept of the World Wide Web through a personified character named Nettikutti, who explains the Internet and the World Wide Web to a group of children. It delves into the history, purpose, and functioning of the Internet in a simple and engaging manner.

source.title: Nilofar
source.author: Arun Kumar
source.illustrator: Aditi Dilip, Deepa Balsavar, Helga Parekh, Jit Chowdhury, Kalyani Ganapathy, Sitara Nikhil

stories.summary: Nilofar, an ordinary girl, has a recurring dream where she controls a huge kite that takes her on fantastical adventures. She explores different landscapes, plays with animals, and experiences freedom and excitement.

source.title: The Magic Pond
source.author: Sudesna Ghosh
source.illustrator: Maitreyi Jugran, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Saurabh Pandey, Suvidha Mistry, Tessa Welch, reddi sai

stories.summary: Shreya, a girl who feels sad about her appearance, discovers a magical pond where she meets a friendly fairy who helps her see her beauty. Through this encounter, Shreya learns to appreciate herself and finds happiness.

source.title: Chimni
source.author: Arun Kumar
source.illustrator: Anupama Ajinkya Apte, Archana Sreenivasan, Deepa Balsavar, Madhuvanti Anantharajan, Natasha Sharma, Preeti Krishnamurthy, Rayika Sen, Ruchi Shah..

stories.summary: Chimni, a unique girl living in an orphanage, is fascinated by birds. When she is adopted and taken to a new home, she goes missing, only to be found on the balcony talking to a sparrow, just like she used to at the orphanage.
A mango tree feels lonely and sad until a bird comes to sit with him, offering companionship without needing to know the reason for his tears.

Raju, Dimpy, and Pinky go to watch a movie after finishing their exams. However, instead of the expected tiger sounds, they hear a frog's croaking, leading to a hilarious turn of events that turns the adventure movie into a comedy.

A group of divers embark on an underwater adventure, encountering a variety of marine creatures like clownfish, sharks, and manta rays. They learn about the different species and ecosystems of the ocean, including corals, plankton, and cleaner wrasses.

source.title: River and Sun
source.author: Havovi
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Greystroke, Jagdish Joshi, Lavanya Karthik, Natasha Sharma, Srikrishna Kedilaya, Sunaina Coelho , Suvidha Mistry

stories.summary: River and Sun are best friends who interact daily. River helps animals, fish, and children on a hot day, while Sun playfully teases River. They reconcile and continue their friendship, with Sun now showing respect to River.

source.title: Can you smile when you snore?
source.author: Mala Kumar
source.illustrator: Sonal Goyal, Sumit Sakhuja, Sumit Sakhuja

stories.summary: Beena and her friends are kept awake by loud snoring. With the help of the Moon and some animal friends, they discover the importance of working, playing, and sleeping together under a special tree, leading to smiles and happiness.

Amit wants to go to the swimming pool with his football but his sister Radha refuses to join. When his football falls into the deep pool, Radha comes to the rescue and retrieves it, making Amit happy.

Rehan goes snorkeling with his mother for the first time and discovers the wonders of the underwater world, encountering colorful fish, rocks, corals, and even a turtle. Despite a moment of fear, he learns and explores the sea with excitement and curiosity.

source.title: Happy Holi!
source.author: Pahi Shrivastava
source.illustrator: Ajit Narayan, Kavita Singh Kale, Madhuri Purandare, Priya Kuriyan, Rijuta Ghate..

stories.summary: Sheela and Ramu discover the joy of Holi celebrations in their city. They convince their mother to join in the fun, bringing smiles to everyone's faces.

source.title: The mouse+dragon
source.author: Pahi Shrivastava
source.illustrator: Deepa Balsavar, Priya Kuriyan, Somesh Kumar, Tanaya Vyas, Tapas Guha, Upamanyu Bhattacharyya..

stories.summary: A lazy dragon named Pitu is transformed into a small rat by a great Baba, leading him on an adventure in the city. After facing challenges and finding a new friend in a grandma, Pitu learns the value of hard work and returns to his dragon form, now a changed and helpful creature.

source.title: The Moon and Daisy
source.author: Joysree Das
source.illustrator: Aditi Dilip, Alison Byrnes, Helga Parekh, Lovely Samhitha, Muniza Shariq, Prashant Miranda

stories.summary: Daisy, a beautiful girl, is captured by the sea-beast Moron and taken to his palace under the sea. With the help of the Moon, Daisy is transformed into a white sea-bird and escapes from Moron's clutches.

source.title: Zara and the butterfly
source.author: Reshma Jannath
source.illustrator: Angie & Upesh, Archana Sreenivasan, Bulbul Sharma, Greystroke, Herminder Ohri, Madhuri Purandare, Rajeev Verma 'Banjara', Rajiv Eipe, Suvidha Mistry..

stories.summary: Zara feels lonely but encounters a magical butterfly that brings joy. The butterfly's influence leads to a chain of kindness and surprises among the community, spreading happiness.

source.title: Food Thieves
source.author: Pahi Shrivastava
source.illustrator: Archana Sreenivasan, Diya Bahukhandi, Greystroke, Muniza Shariq, Reshma Barve, Sonal Goyal..

stories.summary: Owl, Mr. Bat, and baby bat go searching for food and end up eating from a woodcutter's plate. The woodcutter is left puzzled about who took his food.

Shyamlal comes home after a busy day, enjoys a special dinner, and then realizes he has a lot of tasks to complete. He manages to finish all his work by the end of the day, teaching a lesson about responsibility.

source.title: The Nose-less King
source.author: Joysree Das
source.illustrator: Joysree Das, Parismita, Reshma Barve, Tessa Welch

stories.summary: A bulbuli bird steals a gold coin from the king, leading to a series of comical events where the bird outsmarts the king and his soldiers, resulting in the king losing his nose in the end.

Anu admires her Daddy's moustache and enjoys helping him groom it. She also imagines how different people would look with various types of moustaches, including her grandpa who has the best one of all.
The story describes the life cycle of a tree, from a seed to a fully grown tree, emphasizing the growth process and the surrounding green grass.
